theory.intro: Duration problems ask you to find a start time, finish time, or how long something lasts. Work in both $12$-hour (am/pm) and $24$-hour notation.
facts: To convert pm times to $24$-hour, add $12$ to the hour only for hours $1$ through $11$: $3{:}30$ pm $= 15{:}30$. Times in the $12$ pm hour retain hour $12$: $12{:}30$ pm $= 12{:}30$. Times in the $12$ am hour use hour $00$: $12{:}30$ am $= 00{:}30$. Midnight is $00{:}00$, noon is $12{:}00$.
When minutes reach $60$, carry $1$ hour; when hours reach $24$, the time crosses midnight into the next day.
steps: Decide whether you need the start, finish, or duration.
Convert the given times to $24$-hour notation. For elapsed time, add $24$ hours to the end time for each day after the start day.

Use the calculator's sexagesimal button to add the duration to the start, subtract the duration from the finish, or subtract the start from the finish. In manual working, carry at $60$ minutes or borrow $1$ hour as $60$ minutes.
For a finish time of $24{:}00$ or later, subtract $24$ hours and identify the next day. For a negative calculated start, add $24$ hours and identify the previous day.
Write the answer in the notation asked for.

workedExamples.question_text: A movie starts at $5{:}45$ pm and lasts $1$ hour $35$ minutes. When does it finish? Give your answer in 12-hour time.
workedExamples.solution_text:
$5{:}45\text{ pm}=17{:}45$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}17{:}45+1\text{ h }35\text{ min}\\&=19{:}20\end{aligned}$
The movie finishes at $7{:}20$ pm.

workedExamples.question_text: A train journey lasts $2$ hours $25$ minutes and finishes at $01{:}10$ on Wednesday. When did it start? Give the day and 24-hour time.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Subtract the hours, crossing back into Tuesday, then subtract the minutes.
$\begin{aligned}01{:}10-2\text{ h}&=23{:}10\text{ on Tuesday}\\23{:}10-25\text{ min}&=22{:}45\end{aligned}$
The journey started at $22{:}45$ on Tuesday.

workedExamples.question_text: A workshop starts at $9{:}45$ am and ends at $2{:}20$ pm on the same day. How long does it last?
workedExamples.solution_text:
$2{:}20\text{ pm}=14{:}20$
Borrow $1$ hour as $60$ minutes before subtracting.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}14\text{ h }20\text{ min}-9\text{ h }45\text{ min}\\&=13\text{ h }80\text{ min}-9\text{ h }45\text{ min}\\&=4\text{ h }35\text{ min}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: A coach leaves at $22{:}35$ on Friday. The journey takes $4$ hours $50$ minutes. What day and time does it arrive?
workedExamples.solution_text:
Carry $60$ minutes as $1$ hour.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}22{:}35+4\text{ h }50\text{ min}\\&=27{:}25\end{aligned}$
Subtract $24$ hours to find the time on the next day.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}27{:}25-24\text{ h}\\&=03{:}25\end{aligned}$
The coach arrives at $03{:}25$ on Saturday.

workedExamples.question_text:
A movie lasts $154$ minutes.
(a) When does it finish if it starts at $14{:}50$?
(b) When does it start if it finishes at $12{:}15$?
workedExamples.solution_text:
$154\text{ min}=120\text{ min}+34\text{ min}=2\text{ h }34\text{ min}$
(a)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}14{:}50+2\text{ h }34\text{ min}\\&=17{:}24\end{aligned}$
(b)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}12{:}15-2\text{ h }34\text{ min}\\&=09{:}41\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: A camper leaves at $7{:}40$ am on Saturday and returns at $6{:}25$ pm on Monday. How long is the camper away? Give your answer in days, hours and minutes.
workedExamples.solution_text:
$7{:}40\text{ am}=07{:}40$ and $6{:}25\text{ pm}=18{:}25$.
Monday is two days after Saturday, so add $48$ hours to the end time.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}18{:}25+48\text{ h}\\&=66{:}25\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}66\text{ h }25\text{ min}-7\text{ h }40\text{ min}\\&=65\text{ h }85\text{ min}-7\text{ h }40\text{ min}\\&=58\text{ h }45\text{ min}\\&=2\text{ days }10\text{ h }45\text{ min}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: A journey starts at $10{:}35$ pm and ends at $4{:}15$ am the next day. How long does it last?
workedExamples.solution_text:
$10{:}35\text{ pm}=22{:}35$ and $4{:}15\text{ am}=04{:}15$.
Add $24$ hours to the end time because it is on the next day.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}04{:}15+24\text{ h}\\&=28{:}15\end{aligned}$
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}28\text{ h }15\text{ min}-22\text{ h }35\text{ min}\\&=27\text{ h }75\text{ min}-22\text{ h }35\text{ min}\\&=5\text{ h }40\text{ min}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: A bus must arrive at $06{:}20$. Driving takes $2$ hours $35$ minutes, and boarding takes $20$ minutes before departure. What is the latest time boarding can begin?
workedExamples.solution_text:
Subtract the driving time, then the boarding time.
$\begin{aligned}06{:}20-2\text{ h }35\text{ min}&=03{:}45\\03{:}45-20\text{ min}&=03{:}25\end{aligned}$
Boarding can begin at $03{:}25$.

foundation.question_text:
A movie starts at $6{:}35$ pm and lasts $1$ hour $50$ minutes.
When does it finish?
foundation.solution_text:
$6{:}35\text{ pm}+1\text{ h}=7{:}35\text{ pm}$
$7{:}35\text{ pm}+50\text{ min}=8{:}25\text{ pm}$

foundation.question_text:
A training session finishes at $17{:}20$ after lasting $1$ hour $35$ minutes.
When did it start?

A train leaves at $09{:}48$ and arrives at $11{:}12$.
Find the journey duration.

A class starts at $10{:}40$ am and lasts $55$ minutes.
When does it finish?
foundation.solution_text:
$10{:}40+55\text{ min}=11{:}35$
The class finishes at $11{:}35$ am.

foundation.question_text:
A ferry journey lasts $2$ hours $10$ minutes and arrives at $0030$.
Find its departure time.
foundation.solution_text:
$0030-2\text{ h}=2230$
$2230-10\text{ min}=2220$
The ferry left at $2220$ on the previous day.

development.question_text:
A bus leaves at $2255$ on Tuesday and the journey lasts $3$ hours $45$ minutes.
What day and time does it arrive?
development.solution_text:
$22{:}55+3\text{ h }45\text{ min}=26{:}40$
$26{:}40-24\text{ h}=02{:}40$
The bus arrives at $0240$ on Wednesday.

mastery.question_text:
A factory cycle starts at $21{:}48$ on Thursday and lasts $7$ hours $37$ minutes.
What day and time does it finish?
mastery.solution_text:
$21{:}48+7\text{ h }37\text{ min}=29{:}25$
$29{:}25-24\text{ h}=05{:}25$
The cycle finishes at $05{:}25$ on Friday.
